title: Recruited by two men to work as an airplane mechanic as cover
place_text: Air Force training pipeline; Pope Air Force Base, North Carolina

tellings.quote: somewhere early on in the the pipeline I was approached by two individuals who convinced me that um it would be a good idea if I became an airplane mechanic.

plain: Early in his Air Force training in the mid-1990s, two men approached Jake Barber and "convinced me" to become an airplane mechanic, a job he says served as a cover. Barber, a guest who says he once used his helicopter to retrieve a UFO, tells Michels this as his own story, with his path leading to Pope Air Force Base in North Carolina. If true, he was picked out early for secret work hidden behind an ordinary job.
